source: VF5 PS3 dump BLES00029 (release vf5-ps2... vf5-ps3-v1, asset vf5-ps3-games.rar), Dural item obj.bin SKIN blocks (duritm*_obj.bin from model_extracted/dur/)
naming: prefix j_ (joint) / kl_ / n_ (node), suffix _wj; Japanese anatomical names

arm_chain.shoulder: n_skata_l_wj / n_skata_r_wj (skata = shoulder), plus n_skata_b/c variants
arm_chain.forearm: n_sude_l_wj / n_sude_r_wj (sude = forearm), plus n_sude_b variants

face_bones_note: VF5 Dural also carries face bones (kl_ago_wj chin, j_kao_wj face, kl_mabu eyelids, tl_kuti mouth, tl_mayu brows) — unlike Tekken 7's bone-less face
extraction_method: raw byte scan of duritm*_obj.bin for '_wj' name strings; parent hierarchy not decoded (SKIN block format RE open)
